snippet.title: UFO 50 Nonograms - Fangame Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Download now on itch: https://m3zik.itch.io/lx-nonograms

UFO 50 Nonograms is a fangame of Mossmouth's UFO 50. Solve 250 UFO 50 themed Nonogram (Picross) puzzles alongside an incremental progression system!

Trailer music by: ​​⁠@tsk-mus1c 
Original music by Eirik Suhrke

After a year of effort and hundreds of hours, I am extremely happy with how it turned out

If you have any questions, join the UFO 50 Community Discord here http://50games.fans
